_readme: EDIT THIS FILE ONLY. Add, delete or change a hackathon here and every page (timeline, calendar, search, detail) updates automatically — no other file needs to change. Dates must be ISO 8601 with a timezone offset, e.g. 2026-09-17T11:00:00-04:00 for US Eastern or 2026-09-17T21:30:00+05:30 for India. If you don't know an exact time, use 09:00:00 in the right timezone and it will just show as an all-day-ish entry. Status is computed automatically from the current date/time — you never set it by hand.

rounds.name: Idea Submission & Screening
rounds.description: Submit an original idea addressing a real-world problem within your chosen track. Judged on problem understanding, innovation, solution quality, technical feasibility, real-world impact and scalability.

rounds.name: Shortlisting
rounds.description: Round 1 submissions are evaluated and promising teams are shortlisted on innovation, relevance, solution quality, feasibility, impact and scalability.

rounds.name: Build & Prototype
rounds.description: Shortlisted teams build a working prototype. Submit: working prototype, GitHub repo, demo video, project documentation, live demo link if available.

rounds.name: Final Demo & Pitch
rounds.description: Finalists present to the jury: 8 minutes demo & pitch, 5 minutes Q&A. Covers problem, solution, technology, innovation and real-world impact.

rounds.name: Main Hackathon (30 hours)
rounds.description: A 30-hour build sprint. Teams of 1–4 build and submit a functional product under Agentic AI, Open Innovation or Education.
